title: 一般过去时与现在完成时

steps.label: 过去的点
steps.detail: last year · 去年已结束

steps.label: 过去到现在
steps.detail: since May · 从五月延续至今

steps.label: 现在
steps.detail: so far · 截至此刻

diagram.caption: 动作发生在明确结束的过去时间，用 did。描述从过去到现在的经历或状态，用 have / has + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: The shop ___ its first online order last year.
questions.en: Last year places the order in a finished period, so use the simple past, received.
questions.zh: last year 表示已经结束的过去时间，这笔订单用一般过去时 received。

questions.prompt: Our workshop ___ to a larger building two months ago.
questions.en: Two months ago identifies a finished time. Moved is the past form of move.
questions.zh: two months ago 是明确的过去时间，搬迁用过去式 moved。

questions.prompt: The team ___ the new clock at noon yesterday.
questions.en: At noon yesterday gives the completed test a specific past time.
questions.zh: at noon yesterday 指昨天中午的具体时刻，用一般过去时 tested。

questions.prompt: Nora still works in dispatch. She ___ there since April.
questions.en: Since April gives the starting point of a situation that continues now; she takes has worked.
questions.zh: since April 是延续至今的起点，主语 she 用 has worked。

questions.prompt: The filing clerk ___ three folders so far this morning.
questions.en: So far this morning counts completed actions up to the present. Has labeled supplies the present perfect.
questions.zh: so far this morning 统计今天上午截至现在的成果，用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: When ___ the first delivery arrive yesterday?
questions.en: A simple-past question uses did plus the base form arrive. Yesterday fixes the time.
questions.zh: yesterday 表示过去，一般过去时疑问句用 did 加动词原形 arrive。

questions.prompt: This is the first time our branch ___ a repair clinic.
questions.en: This is the first time introduces an experience counted up to now. The singular subject branch takes has hosted.
questions.zh: This is the first time 表示截至目前的首次经历，单数 branch 后用 has hosted。

questions.prompt: The contractor ___ the rear gate in 2019 and replaced it last winter.
questions.en: In 2019 dates the installation, and installed parallels the later simple-past verb replaced.
questions.zh: in 2019 把安装定位在过去，installed 也与后面的 replaced 呼应。

questions.prompt: Since the exchange desk opened, the number of requests ___ from ten a week to thirty.
questions.en: The change extends from the opening to now. The subject is the singular number, and the past participle of rise is risen.
questions.zh: since 从过去的开张延伸至今；主语是单数 the number，rise 的过去分词是 risen。

questions.prompt: Last November the library ___ its first self-service return box.
questions.en: Last November anchors one installation in finished time.
questions.zh: last November 是已结束的时间点，所以用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: The lift is still out of service. It ___ three times since the annual inspection.
questions.en: Since the inspection measures past incidents up to now.
questions.zh: since 引出从检查至今的区间，三次故障用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: How many companies have ___ for the new grant so far?
questions.en: So far includes the present, and have takes a past participle.
questions.zh: so far 表示截至现在，have 后接过去分词 applied。

questions.prompt: The original permit ___ valid for just six months when the town issued it in 2018.
questions.en: The six months belonged to a permit issued in a specified past year.
questions.zh: 2018 年签发的原许可证有效期已经结束，用 was。

questions.prompt: This is the first time that the new sensor ___ a reading below zero.
questions.en: This is the first time calls for present perfect to describe an experience up to now.
questions.zh: This is the first time that… 描述截至现在的首次经历，用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: Sales ___ steadily since the firm added a local pickup option; the latest figures arrived this morning.
questions.en: Since marks a period extending to the present, and sales takes have risen.
questions.zh: since 指从增加自提服务到现在，复数 sales 搭配 have risen。

steps.label: 想象现在
steps.detail: 实际情况相反，或可能性很小

steps.label: If 从句
steps.detail: If we had more space …

steps.label: 想象结果
steps.detail: … we would add a desk.

diagram.caption: 用 If + 一般过去时假设现在或未来的情况，主句用 would + 动词原形表示设想的结果。

questions.prompt: If we had a wider desk, we ___ a second screen on it.
questions.en: The if-clause imagines a different desk now. Use would plus the base form put for its result.
questions.zh: if 从句设想桌面现在更宽，主句用 would 加原形 put。

questions.prompt: If this ticket ___ less, I would reserve a seat today.
questions.en: The imagined lower price calls for the past simple in the if-clause. The past form of cost is also cost.
questions.zh: 设想现在票价更低，if 从句用一般过去时；cost 的过去式也是 cost。

questions.prompt: If the depot had more space, it would ___ the spare chairs on site.
questions.en: Would is followed by the base form of the verb, so use keep.
questions.zh: 情态动词 would 后接动词原形 keep。

questions.prompt: If I ___ the person in charge, I would leave the counter open longer.
questions.en: Were expresses an imagined role in the conventional pattern If I were …, I would … .
questions.zh: If I were … 用 were 表示与现实不同的身份；主句 would 表示设想的做法。

questions.prompt: The office has no lift. If it ___ one, visitors would reach the top floor more easily.
questions.en: The office lacks a lift now. Had expresses the contrary-to-fact condition in the if-clause.
questions.zh: 办公室目前没有电梯。if 从句用过去式 had 假设相反情况。

questions.prompt: If the night bus ran later, fewer employees ___ taxis home.
questions.en: Ran establishes an imagined timetable. Would take expresses the resulting travel choice.
questions.zh: ran 表示设想的时刻表；对应结果用 would take。

questions.prompt: If our binder ___ flat, the pages would be easier to scan.
questions.en: The imagined condition needs the past tense of lie meaning rest in a position. That form is lay.
questions.zh: 表示“平放”的 lie 的过去式是 lay；这里假设文件夹能平放。

questions.prompt: We cannot edit the file. If we ___ access, we would correct the heading ourselves.
questions.en: We would receive permission, so the hypothetical if-clause needs the past passive were granted.
questions.zh: 我们是被授予权限的一方，设想现在拥有权限，用过去时被动语态 were granted。

questions.prompt: If the supplier were to waive the charge, the repair ___ within our present budget.
questions.en: Were to waive sets up an unlikely future possibility. Its result uses would plus the base form fall.
questions.zh: were to waive 表示将来不大可能的假设，结果用 would 加原形 fall。

questions.prompt: If the landlord allowed signs here, we ___ our hours by the entrance.
questions.en: The imagined permission takes would plus the base verb in the result.
questions.zh: 假设获得许可，结果用 would 加动词原形。

questions.prompt: If our two clerks ___ a private office, they would hold interviews there.
questions.en: A hypothetical present situation uses a past form in the if-clause.
questions.zh: 与现在不同的假设用过去式 shared。

questions.prompt: If the company ___ both buildings, it could move its warehouse across the road. It only rents them at present.
questions.en: The company rents the sites, so ownership is an imagined present condition.
questions.zh: 公司实际是租户，假设拥有两栋楼时用过去式 owned。

questions.prompt: If the technicians ___ free to select their hours, they would work after closing. The present contract sets their hours.
questions.en: The current contract prevents that choice. Use were in the unreal condition.
questions.zh: 合同已限制工时，与当前情况相反的假设用 were。

questions.prompt: If the riders objected to a later shuttle, we ___ the early run instead.
questions.en: If plus the past form objected introduces an imagined situation. Its result uses would keep.
questions.zh: if 从句用过去式表示假设，结果用 would 加原形 keep。

questions.prompt: If the training room ___ larger, all four departments could meet there together.
questions.en: Were marks the hypothetical condition. Could introduces its possible result.
questions.zh: 房间并不够大，从句用 were 表示假设。

steps.label: 找中心词
steps.detail: a ___ decision

steps.label: 形容词修饰名词
steps.detail: a careful decision

steps.label: 副词修饰动作
steps.detail: decide carefully

diagram.caption: 先看空格在修饰什么。限定词后的中心词常为名词，形容词描述名词，副词可以修饰动词或形容词。

questions.prompt: Please write your ___ on the visitor sheet.
questions.en: Your introduces a noun naming what the visitor must write. A signature is a written name.
questions.zh: your 后面要填访客写下的东西，signature 表示“签名”。

questions.prompt: The operator checked the seal ___ before starting the pump.
questions.en: Carefully is an adverb describing how the operator checked the seal.
questions.zh: 这里说明检查的方式，用副词 carefully 修饰 checked。

questions.prompt: The training room has a ___ entrance at the side.
questions.en: Separate is an adjective describing the noun entrance.
questions.zh: 名词 entrance 前需要形容词，a separate entrance 是“独立入口”。

questions.prompt: The store plans to ___ the unused shelves next week.
questions.en: Plans to is followed by a base verb; remove means to take the shelves away.
questions.zh: plans to 后用动词原形；remove the shelves 表示“移走货架”。

questions.prompt: The color chart is ___ useful when ordering replacement tiles.
questions.en: Especially modifies the adjective useful and emphasizes the degree of usefulness.
questions.zh: 修饰形容词 useful 用副词 especially，表示“特别有用”。

questions.prompt: A written ___ of the fault will help the engineer prepare.
questions.en: The article and adjective a written need a head noun. Description names the account of the fault.
questions.zh: a written 后面需要中心名词。description of the fault 是“故障的书面说明”。

questions.prompt: The labels must remain ___ even in dim light.
questions.en: Remain links the labels to a quality. Readable is the adjective meaning easy to read.
questions.zh: remain 是系动词，后接表示标签状态的形容词 readable。

questions.prompt: An ___ timed pause gave the presenter a moment to replace the cable.
questions.en: The adverb appropriately modifies timed. Together, appropriately timed describes pause.
questions.zh: appropriately 修饰 timed，二者一起修饰 pause，表示“时机恰当的停顿”。

questions.prompt: The director praised the team's ___ in tracking down the missing shipment.
questions.en: The possessive team's needs a noun for the quality being praised. Persistence names sustained effort.
questions.zh: team's 后需表示受表扬品质的名词，persistence 意为“坚持不懈”。

questions.prompt: The front desk is responsible for ___ visitors' badges at closing time.
questions.en: For is a preposition. The following verb takes -ing and its object is badges.
questions.zh: 介词 for 后接动名词，badges 是其宾语。

questions.prompt: The analyst avoided ___ the same fee in both columns.
questions.en: Avoid takes an -ing complement.
questions.zh: avoid 后接动名词 listing。

questions.prompt: The buyer agreed ___ the rates before signing anything.
questions.en: Agree takes a to-infinitive to describe the promised action.
questions.zh: agree to do 表示同意做某事。

questions.prompt: The new portal enables tenants ___ faults after hours.
questions.en: Enable takes an object followed by a to-infinitive.
questions.zh: enable tenants to report 是使租户能够报修。

questions.prompt: Leave the ___ invoices in the tray until the bank confirms payment.
questions.en: The participial adjective describes invoices for which payment is outstanding.
questions.zh: 修饰尚未结清的发票，用过去分词形容词 unpaid。

questions.prompt: The ___ charge on page two covers storage for one additional night.
questions.en: The charge is listed separately, so the passive participle modifies charge.
questions.zh: 这笔收费被单列，过去分词 itemized 修饰 charge。

steps.label: 地点
steps.detail: at the desk · 在柜台

steps.label: 时间
steps.detail: by Friday · 最迟周五

steps.label: 持续
steps.detail: for two weeks · 持续两周

diagram.caption: 先判断关系是地点、期限或时长，再检查固定搭配。by 是截止点，until 强调状态一直持续。

questions.prompt: The appointment is ___ 9:15 on Thursday morning.
questions.en: Use at before a precise clock time such as 9:15.
questions.zh: 具体几点钟前用 at，星期几前用 on。

questions.prompt: The new café opens ___ Monday.
questions.en: Use on with the name of a day.
questions.zh: 表示在星期几，用介词 on。

questions.prompt: The help desk stayed open ___ three extra hours.
questions.en: For introduces a length of time, here three hours.
questions.zh: three extra hours 是一段时长，前面用 for。

questions.prompt: The ramp runs ___ the parking lot to the lobby entrance.
questions.en: From pairs with to to mark the start and end of the ramp.
questions.zh: from 与 to 搭配，分别标出坡道的起点和终点。

questions.prompt: The mail room is closed ___ noon; it reopens at exactly twelve.
questions.en: Until marks the end of the period during which the room is closed.
questions.zh: until 表示关闭状态持续到中午，与十二点重开呼应。

questions.prompt: The coordinator is responsible ___ updating the seating chart.
questions.en: The fixed phrase responsible for introduces the task assigned to someone.
questions.zh: be responsible for 表示“负责”，介词 for 后可接动名词。

questions.prompt: Please divide the cost equally ___ the two branches.
questions.en: Between fits a division involving two specified branches.
questions.zh: 表示在两个明确对象之间分摊，用 between。

questions.prompt: The replacement hinge differs ___ the original in thickness.
questions.en: Differ from introduces the item used for comparison; in thickness states the difference.
questions.zh: differ from 表示“与……不同”，in thickness 说明差异在厚度。

questions.prompt: The order was filled in accordance ___ the revised specifications.
questions.en: In accordance with is the fixed expression meaning in agreement with a rule or specification.
questions.zh: in accordance with 是固定搭配，表示“按照、依据”。

questions.prompt: The parking area remained open ___ the brief power failure.
questions.en: During takes the noun phrase the brief power failure.
questions.zh: 空后是名词短语，表示期间用 during。

questions.prompt: The clerk stayed at the counter ___ her colleague checked the van.
questions.en: Her colleague checked the van is a clause needing a conjunction.
questions.zh: 空后有主谓结构，需要连词 while。

questions.prompt: Outdoor sales fell ___ the unusually cold weather.
questions.en: The cause is a noun phrase after because of.
questions.zh: 寒冷天气是名词短语，用 because of 引出原因。

questions.prompt: Keep the envelopes sealed ___ the secretary arrives.
questions.en: Until introduces the clause giving the end of the waiting period.
questions.zh: 空后是完整从句，until 引出截止时间。

questions.prompt: ___ the narrow entrance, the crew brought the cabinet inside in one piece.
questions.en: Despite takes the noun phrase the narrow entrance and introduces an obstacle.
questions.zh: 入口狭窄却搬进整柜，用 despite 加名词短语。

questions.prompt: The dispatch sheet was changed ___ two drivers called in sick.
questions.en: Two drivers called in sick gives a reason in a full clause.
questions.zh: 原因以完整从句出现，要用连词 because。

steps.label: 看两边结构
steps.detail: 主语 + 谓语？还是名词短语？

steps.label: 判断逻辑
steps.detail: 原因 / 让步 / 条件

steps.label: 选择连接词
steps.detail: because / although / unless

diagram.caption: 连词可以引导有主语和谓语的从句。because of、despite 等介词表达式后接名词短语。

questions.prompt: The shop closed early ___ the lights went out.
questions.en: The lights went out is a clause giving the reason. Because introduces that clause.
questions.zh: the lights went out 是完整的原因从句，用 because 引导。

questions.prompt: Bring a pen ___ a copy of the signed form.
questions.en: And joins two items that both need to be brought.
questions.zh: a pen 和 a copy 是两个都要携带的物品，用 and 连接。

questions.prompt: ___ the handle is small, it can support a heavy case.
questions.en: The small handle contrasts with its strength. Although introduces the complete clause the handle is small.
questions.zh: 把手虽小却很结实，前后构成让步关系；although 后接完整从句。

questions.prompt: The shop offers either home delivery ___ collection at the counter.
questions.en: Either … or presents two alternatives.
questions.zh: either … or … 表示“或者……或者……”。

questions.prompt: Keep the lamp connected ___ the green indicator appears, then unplug it.
questions.en: Until gives the endpoint of the instruction to keep the lamp connected.
questions.zh: 绿灯亮起是保持连接的终点，故用 until。

questions.prompt: No one may enter the storeroom ___ a supervisor is present.
questions.en: Unless means except if. A supervisor's presence is the condition for entry.
questions.zh: unless 表示“除非”。主管在场是允许进入的条件。

questions.prompt: We attached a map ___ first-time visitors could locate the back gate.
questions.en: So that introduces the purpose of attaching the map.
questions.zh: 附地图的目的是方便初访者找到后门，so that 引导目的从句。

questions.prompt: The north kiosk accepts coins, ___ the south kiosk accepts cards only.
questions.en: Whereas highlights a contrast between the payment methods at the two kiosks.
questions.zh: 前后在对比两个服务亭的付款方式，whereas 表示“而”。

questions.prompt: The repair can proceed provided ___ the spare part passes inspection.
questions.en: Provided that introduces the condition on which the repair may proceed.
questions.zh: provided that 表示“条件是、只要”，后接完整从句。

questions.prompt: Send the label today ___ we can have the parcel ready for Monday.
questions.en: Having the parcel ready is the purpose of sending the label.
questions.zh: 后句是目的，so that 表示以便。

questions.prompt: The cameras were cheap to buy, ___ the replacement lenses were expensive.
questions.en: The second cost contrasts with the first.
questions.zh: 机身便宜而镜头贵，两个并列分句是转折关系。

questions.prompt: A missing postal code blocks acceptance. The printer will reject the batch ___ every entry has a postal code.
questions.en: The batch is accepted only if every entry has the required code.
questions.zh: 除非每条记录都有邮编，否则拒收。

questions.prompt: We can offer ___ a refund or a seat at next month's session.
questions.en: Either pairs with or to present two options.
questions.zh: 两个选择用 either…or。

questions.prompt: The account is active, ___ the card itself has expired.
questions.en: Although introduces a contrast between the account and the card.
questions.zh: 账户有效与卡片过期形成转折。

questions.prompt: Check the roof seals now ___ water enters the archive during the next storm.
questions.en: Inspecting now must precede the possible entry of rainwater.
questions.zh: 要在雨水进入之前检查，before 表示先后顺序。

steps.label: 人
steps.detail: the clerk who called

steps.label: 物
steps.detail: the badge which fell

steps.label: 所属
steps.detail: a guest whose bag is missing

diagram.caption: 先找到被修饰的先行词，再检查它在从句中充当主语、宾语、所属成分，还是地点或时间状语。

questions.prompt: The mechanic ___ fixed the lift left a service note.
questions.en: The antecedent is a person and the clause needs the subject of fixed. Use who.
questions.zh: 先行词是人，从句缺 fixed 的主语，故用 who。

questions.prompt: The chair, ___ folds flat, fits in the cupboard.
questions.en: The nonrestrictive clause needs a subject referring to the chair. Which refers to things.
questions.zh: 逗号后的非限制性定语从句缺主语，先行词 chair 是物，用 which。

questions.prompt: Please contact the guest ___ suitcase is still in storage.
questions.en: The suitcase belongs to the guest. Whose marks this possessive relationship.
questions.zh: suitcase 属于这位客人，用 whose 表示所属关系。

questions.prompt: The café ___ we usually meet will reopen next week.
questions.en: We usually meet is complete and needs a location, so use where meaning at which.
questions.zh: we usually meet 的主谓完整，从句需要地点状语，用 where。

questions.prompt: The date ___ the old passes expire is printed in red.
questions.en: The passes expire on that date, so the relative word supplies time, not the subject.
questions.zh: the old passes expire 已有主谓，when 表示“在这个日期”。

questions.prompt: The drawer in ___ we keep the spare keys is jammed.
questions.en: After the fronted preposition in, use which to refer to the drawer.
questions.zh: 介词 in 提到了关系词前面，指物时用 which，构成 in which。

questions.prompt: The customer to ___ the parcel was addressed has moved.
questions.en: The relative pronoun follows the preposition to and refers to a person, so whom is required here.
questions.zh: 介词 to 后指人，正式结构中用宾格 whom。

questions.prompt: The printer skipped six pages, ___ meant the report had to be printed again.
questions.en: Which refers to the entire preceding event: six pages were skipped.
questions.zh: which 在逗号后指代前面“跳过六页”这整件事。

questions.prompt: We tested four designs, none of ___ met the weight limit.
questions.en: None of which introduces a supplementary clause about the four designs. Use which after of.
questions.zh: none of which 引导补充说明四款设计的从句，介词 of 后用 which 指代 designs。

questions.prompt: The driver to ___ the red gate permit was issued must return it in person.
questions.en: To precedes the relative pronoun for the person who received the permit.
questions.zh: 先行词是人，介词 to 后用宾格关系代词 whom。

questions.prompt: The inspector found an invoice ___ total had been changed by hand.
questions.en: Whose shows that the total belongs to the invoice.
questions.zh: total 是该发票的总额，用 whose 表示所属。

questions.prompt: The shelf on ___ the signed registers are kept is behind the payroll desk.
questions.en: The relative pronoun follows on and refers to the shelf. Where already includes a locative relation.
questions.zh: 先行词是架子，介词 on 后接 which，不能再接 where。

questions.prompt: The supplier ___ warehouse flooded will use our loading bay this week.
questions.en: The warehouse belongs to the supplier, so use possessive whose.
questions.zh: 仓库属于该供应商，关系词用表所属的 whose。

questions.prompt: The candidates, two of ___ have worked abroad, will meet the board today.
questions.en: Of whom links the two candidates to the plural antecedent in a relative clause.
questions.zh: of 后用宾格关系代词 whom，将从句连到 candidates。

questions.prompt: The survey includes six drawings, none of ___ show the final entrance.
questions.en: The relative clause attaches with none of which. Them would leave a comma splice.
questions.zh: 逗号后需关系从句，none of which 正确；them 无法连接两个分句。

steps.label: 同等
steps.detail: as light as …

steps.label: 两者比较
steps.detail: lighter than …

steps.label: 一组之最
steps.detail: the lightest of the three

diagram.caption: than 常引出比较对象。as … as 中间用原级。在明确的一组中强调最突出的一项，用最高级。

questions.prompt: This cart is ___ than the one we returned.
questions.en: Than signals a comparison. Lighter is the comparative of light.
questions.zh: than 表示两者比较，light 的比较级是 lighter。

questions.prompt: Of the five meeting rooms, Oak is the ___.
questions.en: Of the five defines a group, and the refers to the room at the lowest extreme in size.
questions.zh: 在五间会议室中找最小的一间，用最高级 smallest。

questions.prompt: The spare key is just as ___ as the original.
questions.en: As … as takes an adjective in its base form. Useful describes the key.
questions.zh: as … as 中间用原级形容词，useful 描述钥匙。

questions.prompt: After we removed the divider, the waiting area felt ___ spacious than before.
questions.en: More makes the comparative more spacious, which pairs with than.
questions.zh: spacious 的比较级用 more spacious，与 than 搭配。

questions.prompt: The revised layout uses ___ sheets of paper than the old one.
questions.en: Sheets is a plural count noun. Fewer … than compares the number of sheets.
questions.zh: sheets 是复数可数名词，比较张数用 fewer … than。

questions.prompt: The new kettle uses ___ electricity than the larger model.
questions.en: Electricity is uncountable, so compare amounts with less.
questions.zh: electricity 是不可数名词，比较用电量用 less。

questions.prompt: The second estimate is considerably ___ than the first.
questions.en: Considerably can intensify a comparative, and than introduces the item being compared.
questions.zh: considerably 可修饰比较级，后面又有 than，因此选 lower。

questions.prompt: The more clearly the boxes are marked, the ___ they are to sort.
questions.en: The more …, the easier … links two changes. Easy describes the boxes in they are easy to sort.
questions.zh: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表示“越……越……”，此处用形容词比较级 easier。

questions.prompt: Of the two routes under discussion, the river road is the ___ one.
questions.en: The sentence compares just two routes. The shorter one identifies the one with less distance.
questions.zh: 只比较两条路线，用 the shorter one 指其中较短的那条。

questions.prompt: The revised form has ___ boxes than the original; pages three and four were removed.
questions.en: Boxes are countable and than calls for a comparative.
questions.zh: boxes 可数且作比较，要用 fewer。

questions.prompt: The second application requires ___ paperwork than the first one.
questions.en: Paperwork is an uncountable noun.
questions.zh: paperwork 不可数，比较数量用 less。

questions.prompt: The hall now has twice as ___ exits as the old building.
questions.en: Exits is plural and countable in the as many as pattern.
questions.zh: exits 是复数可数名词，用 twice as many…as。

questions.prompt: The compact boiler uses only half as ___ fuel as its predecessor.
questions.en: Fuel is measured as an amount in the as much as pattern.
questions.zh: fuel 表示不可数的燃料量，用 as much fuel as。

questions.prompt: This packet holds one numbered washer; the larger packet holds three times as ___.
questions.en: A numbered washer is one countable object. The second clause omits washers after many.
questions.zh: 有编号的垫圈是可数的物件，后句省略复数 washers，数量比较用 many。

questions.prompt: The second coat used far ___ paint than we budgeted for, so we returned an unopened tin.
questions.en: Returning a full tin indicates a smaller amount of uncountable paint.
questions.zh: 退回整罐说明用量更少，paint 不可数，选 less。

steps.label: 动作接受者
steps.detail: the boxes · 箱子

steps.label: be 决定时态
steps.detail: are / were / will be

steps.label: 过去分词
steps.detail: are sealed · 被封好

diagram.caption: 动作的接受者作主语时，用 be + 过去分词。完成时被动为 have / has been + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: Every parcel is ___ before it leaves the depot.
questions.en: The parcel receives the action. Is plus the past participle weighed forms the passive.
questions.zh: 包裹是被称重的对象，is 后接过去分词 weighed。

questions.prompt: The windows ___ cleaned by a contractor yesterday.
questions.en: Yesterday sets the action in the past. The plural subject windows takes were cleaned.
questions.zh: yesterday 提示过去时间，复数 windows 对应 were cleaned。

questions.prompt: All expenses must ___ approved by a manager.
questions.en: A modal passive uses modal + be + past participle, here must be approved.
questions.zh: 情态动词的被动结构是“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”，这里是 must be approved。

questions.prompt: The samples will be ___ to the lab in the morning.
questions.en: Will be needs a past participle to make the future passive. Sent is the participle of send.
questions.zh: 将来时被动为 will be + 过去分词；send 的过去分词是 sent。

questions.prompt: Access to the roof ___ restricted during the storm last night.
questions.en: Access is singular, and last night calls for the past passive was restricted.
questions.zh: 主语 access 是单数，last night 表示过去，故用 was restricted。

questions.prompt: An extra shift has just ___ added to the schedule.
questions.en: The present-perfect passive is has been added. The shift receives the action.
questions.zh: 现在完成时被动结构是 has been added，排班表新增的是一个班次。

questions.prompt: Use the front door; the side entrance is currently being ___.
questions.en: Is being repaired is the present progressive passive, describing work in progress.
questions.zh: is being + 过去分词 是现在进行时的被动结构，表示正在维修。

questions.prompt: Before the guests arrived, every table had already ___ set.
questions.en: Had been set is a past-perfect passive. Setting the tables preceded the guests' arrival.
questions.zh: 摆桌先于客人到达，且桌子是被摆好的，故用过去完成时被动 had been set。

questions.prompt: The crates appear to have ___ damaged during loading.
questions.en: Appear to have been damaged uses the perfect passive infinitive for earlier damage to the crates.
questions.zh: appear 后的完成式被动不定式 to have been damaged 表示箱子似乎先前曾受损。

questions.prompt: Packages ___ to the rear desk are scanned before noon.
questions.en: Packages receive the action. Delivered shortens that are delivered.
questions.zh: 包裹被送到后门，过去分词相当于被动定语从句。

questions.prompt: The names ___ below have been checked against the original register.
questions.en: Names are listed, so a passive participle modifies them.
questions.zh: 被列出的名字用过去分词 listed 作后置修饰。

questions.prompt: Attach the receipt ___ by the ticket machine to the paper form.
questions.en: The machine issues the receipt. The receipt is the object of issue.
questions.zh: 收据由机器开具，修饰收据用 issued。

questions.prompt: A letter ___ by both owners is required to transfer the account.
questions.en: Both owners sign the letter, making signed the passive modifier.
questions.zh: 信件被两位业主签署，过去分词 signed 合适。

questions.prompt: Once the items have ___ counted, put a green dot on the carton.
questions.en: Have been counted is a present perfect passive.
questions.zh: 物品已经被点数，用 have been counted。

questions.prompt: Last Friday the temporary bridge ___ to cyclists for the first time.
questions.en: Last Friday is finished time. The bridge received the action.
questions.zh: 上周五是已结束时间，桥被开放用一般过去时的被动。

steps.label: 普通语序
steps.detail: We rarely change labels.

steps.label: 否定副词前置
steps.detail: Rarely …

steps.label: 助动词前置
steps.detail: … do we change labels.

diagram.caption: 否定或限制性表达置于句首时，主句常用部分倒装。已有助动词就前移，否则用 do / does / did，再接主语和动词原形。

questions.prompt: Never ___ we seen this many visitors at a weekday sale.
questions.en: Negative never at the front triggers inversion. Seen needs have in the present perfect.
questions.zh: Never 置于句首引起倒装，seen 为过去分词，与 have 构成现在完成时。

questions.prompt: Rarely ___ the lift stop between floors; it is normally reliable.
questions.en: For an ordinary present-tense verb with the singular subject lift, negative inversion uses does + subject + base verb.
questions.zh: Rarely 前置，单数 lift 的一般现在时倒装用 does，再接动词原形 stop。

questions.prompt: Only after the doors opened ___ the queue begin to move.
questions.en: The past event needs did before the subject and the base form begin after it.
questions.zh: Only after 引出的时间状语置于句首，主句用 did 倒装，后接原形 begin。

questions.prompt: At no time ___ visitors permitted to handle the samples during yesterday's tour.
questions.en: The negative phrase triggers inversion of were permitted. Visitors is plural and yesterday sets past time.
questions.zh: At no time 置首使被动句倒装，复数 visitors 与过去时间共同决定用 were。

questions.prompt: Not only ___ the courier collect the parcel, but she also brought new labels yesterday.
questions.en: Not only at the front inverts the first clause. Use did with the base verb collect for yesterday's action.
questions.zh: Not only 置首使第一分句倒装，昨天的动作用 did 加原形 collect。

questions.prompt: No sooner had we posted the notice ___ the first inquiry arrived.
questions.en: No sooner … than is the paired construction for one event immediately following another.
questions.zh: no sooner … than 是固定结构，表示“一……就……”。

questions.prompt: Hardly had the floor dried ___ another delivery arrived.
questions.en: Hardly had … when describes an event that followed almost immediately.
questions.zh: Hardly had … when 表示前一件事刚完成，后一件事就发生了。

questions.prompt: ___ the sensor to fail, the backup alarm would sound.
questions.en: Were the sensor to fail is an inverted version of If the sensor were to fail.
questions.zh: Were the sensor to fail 是把 If the sensor were to fail 省略 if 后倒装的虚拟条件句。

questions.prompt: Not until the final sample was weighed ___ that the scale was inaccurate.
questions.en: Not until introduces the opening time clause. Invert the main clause: did we realize.
questions.zh: Not until 时间从句置首，主句要倒装，用 did we realize；时间从句本身保持正常语序。

questions.prompt: Only after both keys were returned ___ the guard release the deposit.
questions.en: Fronted only after triggers inversion; release is a base verb in a past event.
questions.zh: only after 置于句首引起倒装，过去事件且动词原形要用 did。

questions.prompt: Not until the final page ___ the contract mention a cancellation fee.
questions.en: Mention is a base verb. The singular contract takes does in present inversion.
questions.zh: 否定成分前置，用 does 加主语再接原形 mention。

questions.prompt: So narrow ___ the service passage that the crew had to unpack the desk outside.
questions.en: With a fronted adjective, the linking verb was precedes the singular subject.
questions.zh: so 加形容词前置，单数主语与系动词 was 倒装。

questions.prompt: Had the van arrived earlier, the team ___ have completed the installation before noon.
questions.en: Had the van arrived stands for if the van had arrived. The result uses would have.
questions.zh: Had 提前相当于 if 从句，过去假设的结果用 would have。

questions.prompt: Never before ___ a single branch sold so many advance tickets in one hour.
questions.en: Negative fronting requires an auxiliary before the singular subject a single branch.
questions.zh: 否定词前置，完成时助动词位于单数主语前，故用 has。

questions.prompt: At the far end of the yard ___ two sheds that the lease does not cover.
questions.en: In this locative inversion, two sheds is the plural subject of stand.
questions.zh: 地点状语前置，真正主语 two sheds 为复数。

steps.label: 人是谁？
steps.detail: 先找代词要指的对象。

steps.label: 句中位置
steps.detail: 主语 they，动词或介词后的宾语 them。

steps.label: 名词前后
steps.detail: their + 名词；theirs 单独表示所属；主宾同一用 themselves。

diagram.caption: their + 名词；theirs 单独表示所属；主宾同一用 themselves。

questions.prompt: The installers left ___ tools in the delivery van and had to collect them.
questions.en: The noun “tools” needs a possessive determiner before it.
questions.zh: tools 前需要所有格限定词 their。

questions.prompt: The brown sample belongs to us. The white one is ___.
questions.en: The possessive pronoun stands alone for their sample.
questions.zh: 空格独立表示他们的样品，选名词性物主代词。

questions.prompt: The owner checked the lock ___, without asking a technician to come.
questions.en: The reflexive emphasizes that the owner personally did the checking.
questions.zh: 店主亲自检查，反身代词表强调。

questions.prompt: For security reasons, the bank asks callers to identify ___ before discussing a transfer.
questions.en: Callers identify the same people doing the identifying.
questions.zh: 来电者验证自己的身份，用复数反身代词。

questions.prompt: Please forward the booking number to ___ as soon as our room is confirmed.
questions.en: To needs an object. The people receiving the number are distinct from the person sending it.
questions.zh: to 后接受事宾格 us，接收方与收件指令的执行者不同。

questions.prompt: Of the two estimates, ___ with the longer warranty costs less.
questions.en: The sentence selects a single estimate and uses the singular verb costs.
questions.zh: 从两份报价中指有较长保修的那一份，后接单数 costs。

questions.prompt: My desk has a drawer, but ___ has a small safe instead.
questions.en: Yours stands for your desk and serves as the subject.
questions.zh: yours 代替 your desk，在分句中作主语。

questions.prompt: The installer inspected the work himself, and the owner then checked it ___.
questions.en: The owner performed a second check personally, so use the emphatic reflexive.
questions.zh: 业主也亲自检查了一次，herself 表示强调。

questions.prompt: The agency gave each visitor a badge and asked ___ to wear it upstairs.
questions.en: Asked takes an object before the infinitive. Them refers back to the visitors.
questions.zh: ask 后先接宾格，再接不定式。

questions.prompt: The cashier handed the two keys back to ___ who had signed for them, one key per visitor.
questions.en: Those who means the people who. Their is a determiner and cannot head this phrase.
questions.zh: those who 表示那些签领过钥匙的人。

questions.prompt: I returned my own visitor pass, but the courier left ___ on the dashboard of her van.
questions.en: Hers stands for her visitor pass without repeating the noun.
questions.zh: 空后无名词，hers 代替她的访客证。

questions.prompt: The two editors read each ___ notes before sending the single agreed draft.
questions.en: Each other's is the reciprocal possessive for the two editors.
questions.zh: 两位编辑彼此的笔记，用 each other's。

questions.prompt: The board appointed Mara as chair and gave ___ authority to set the meeting dates.
questions.en: Give takes an object naming the recipient of authority.
questions.zh: give 后接宾格作为接受授权的人。

questions.prompt: The blank forms are in the drawer. Please take ___ for each member of your group.
questions.en: One stands for one blank form per member.
questions.zh: 每人一份，用单数 one 代替 a form。

questions.prompt: The latest rate is higher than ___ shown on the original invoice.
questions.en: That replaces the singular noun rate in the comparison.
questions.zh: 比较的是两个单数价格，用 that 代替 the rate。

steps.label: 动作前的词
steps.detail: 先看前面的动词或介词。

steps.label: -ing
steps.detail: 介词和 avoid、postpone 后接 doing。

steps.label: to + 原形
steps.detail: agree、offer、afford 后接 to do；let 和 have 后的补语可用原形。

diagram.caption: agree、offer、afford 后接 to do；let 和 have 后的补语可用原形。

questions.prompt: The crew postponed ___ the carpet until the paint was dry.
questions.en: Postpone takes an -ing form for the delayed activity.
questions.zh: postpone 后接动名词，表示推迟铺设。

questions.prompt: The clerk offered ___ the forms while the customer waited.
questions.en: Offer takes a to-infinitive when volunteering to act.
questions.zh: 主动提出做某事用 offer to do。

questions.prompt: Before ___ the freezer, move the samples into cold storage.
questions.en: Here before is followed by a nonfinite activity with the same implied subject as move.
questions.zh: before 后无从句主语，动作 unplug 用动名词。

questions.prompt: The safety officer reminded the staff ___ the side gate at night.
questions.en: Remind someone to do something gives a prompt for a future action.
questions.zh: 提醒员工记得锁门，remind sb. to do。

questions.prompt: Staff are expected ___ from the gate until the crane stops.
questions.en: Be expected takes a to-infinitive.
questions.zh: be expected 后接不定式表示应采取的行动。

questions.prompt: Consider ___ the start later to give drivers time to park.
questions.en: Consider takes a gerund for a possible action.
questions.zh: consider doing 表示考虑一个做法。

questions.prompt: We cannot afford ___ a second chiller until next quarter.
questions.en: Afford takes a to-infinitive.
questions.zh: 负担得起购买某物，afford 后接 to buy。

questions.prompt: The shop is committed to ___ its old packaging by June.
questions.en: To in committed to is a preposition.
questions.zh: be committed to 的 to 是介词，接 replacing。

questions.prompt: The manager had the porter ___ the locked cabinet to room six.
questions.en: Causative have with a person takes a bare infinitive.
questions.zh: have sb. do sth. 表示安排某人做某事。

questions.prompt: The tradespeople finished ___ the last shelf shortly before the store opened.
questions.en: Finish is followed by a gerund naming the completed activity.
questions.zh: finish 后接动名词 fitting。

questions.prompt: Remember ___ the spare key tomorrow; it is still on your desk.
questions.en: Remember to do concerns a task that still needs to happen.
questions.zh: 明天带钥匙仍待执行，用 remember to do。

questions.prompt: The chef denied ___ the supplier's original invoice; she said it was still in the office.
questions.en: Deny takes an -ing form when rejecting a claim about one's action.
questions.zh: 否认做过某事用 deny doing。

questions.prompt: Several staff members volunteered ___ an extra afternoon at the registration desk.
questions.en: Volunteer takes a to-infinitive describing the offered help.
questions.zh: 自愿从事某事用 volunteer to work。

questions.prompt: Installing the reader involves ___ a small panel beside the main door.
questions.en: Involve takes a gerund for a step in the process.
questions.zh: 涉及一个操作步骤，用 involve doing。

questions.prompt: The business decided against ___ a second cash account this year.
questions.en: Against is a preposition, so the action is expressed with a gerund.
questions.zh: against 为介词，后接 opening。

steps.label: 判断被修饰名词
steps.detail: 是动作发出者，还是动作承受者？

steps.label: 主动 → -ing
steps.detail: the notice warning visitors = 告示主动提醒。

steps.label: 被动 → 过去分词
steps.detail: the receipt issued yesterday = 收据被开具。

diagram.caption: the receipt issued yesterday = 收据被开具。

questions.prompt: Passengers ___ for a connecting bus should stay in the marked lane.
questions.en: The passengers are doing the waiting; use the present participle.
questions.zh: 乘客主动等待，用 waiting 作后置修饰。

questions.prompt: Workers ___ to enter the test room have a blue stamp on their badges.
questions.en: The workers receive authorization from someone else.
questions.zh: 员工获准进入，过去分词 authorized 表被动。

questions.prompt: The notice ___ visitors about falling tiles is beside the lift.
questions.en: The notice actively warns visitors, so warning introduces a reduced relative clause.
questions.zh: 告示提醒访客，用主动的现在分词 warning。

questions.prompt: An email ___ the proposed timetable arrived this morning.
questions.en: The email sets out the timetable, so the modifier is active.
questions.zh: 电子邮件列出时间表，主动关系用 outlining。

questions.prompt: Use the cable ___ around the black spool by the night crew, not the loose cable on the bench.
questions.en: Someone wound the cable around the spool. The passive participle is wound.
questions.zh: 线缆被绕在线轴上，wind 的过去分词是 wound。

questions.prompt: Patrons ___ in the ceramics class receive a shelf number.
questions.en: Enrolled in describes patrons who have been registered.
questions.zh: 已经报名的顾客，用 enrolled in 作定语。

questions.prompt: The technician inspected the cartons ___ under the leaking pipe.
questions.en: The cartons had been put there in a pile.
questions.zh: 纸箱被堆放在管道下，用 stacked。

questions.prompt: A message ___ that the payment had cleared appeared on the screen.
questions.en: The message conveys the confirmation and actively introduces a that-clause.
questions.zh: 信息主动确认款项到账，confirming 后可接 that 从句。

questions.prompt: Orders ___ after six are processed the following morning.
questions.en: The business receives orders, so orders are received.
questions.zh: 订单是被接收的对象，选 received。

questions.prompt: A folder ___ blue tape on its spine contains the revised floor plan.
questions.en: The folder carries the tape, so bearing describes the active relationship.
questions.zh: 文件夹带有胶带，主动关系用 bearing。

questions.prompt: The two scale models ___ in the lobby were donated by local designers.
questions.en: Someone put the models on display, so exhibited modifies the models.
questions.zh: 模型被展出，用过去分词 exhibited。

questions.prompt: The forms ___ during the move had to be printed again.
questions.en: The forms were lost by someone during the move.
questions.zh: 表格在搬迁时被放错位置，是被动关系。

questions.prompt: A vendor ___ reusable crates gave the lowest quotation.
questions.en: The vendor offers the crates. Offering introduces its modifier.
questions.zh: 供应商主动提供货箱，用 offering。

questions.prompt: The route ___ the island to the mainland closes at dusk.
questions.en: The route connects two places, so the linking phrase is active.
questions.zh: 路线将两地相连，linking 带两个地点作补充信息。

questions.prompt: Include the letter ___ from the registrar in your application.
questions.en: The registrar sent the letter and the applicant received it.
questions.zh: 信来自登记员，被申请者收到，用 received。

steps.label: 锁定主语中心
steps.detail: 先划去 of、along with 等附加成分。

steps.label: 判断单复数
steps.detail: Each of the lockers → each 为单数。

steps.label: 匹配谓语
steps.detail: Each has a hook. 复数 boxes 则用 have。

diagram.caption: Each has a hook. 复数 boxes 则用 have。

questions.prompt: Each of the lockers ___ a separate hook for a helmet.
questions.en: Each is the singular head of the subject.
questions.zh: 主语中心 each 为单数，谓语用 has。

questions.prompt: Neither the helpline nor the branch offices ___ payments by telephone.
questions.en: The nearer subject branch offices is plural.
questions.zh: 就近主语 branch offices 为复数。

questions.prompt: The price of both replacement filters ___ delivery and fitting.
questions.en: The singular subject is price, not filters.
questions.zh: 主语是单数 price，filters 属于介词短语。

questions.prompt: Two hours ___ enough time for the team to fit the new sign.
questions.en: The time span is treated as one amount, taking singular is.
questions.zh: 两小时作为一个时长整体处理，用单数 is。

questions.prompt: A set of three handbooks ___ inside every starter kit.
questions.en: The singular noun set determines the verb.
questions.zh: 主语中心 set 为单数。

questions.prompt: The posters, along with a folding stand, ___ already in the van.
questions.en: Along with does not change the plural subject posters.
questions.zh: along with 引出的成分不改变主语 posters 的复数。

questions.prompt: Every lamp and every fan in this wing ___ a numbered inspection sticker.
questions.en: Every before each coordinated singular noun calls for a singular verb.
questions.zh: 两个单数名词前各有 every，作为整体用单数谓语。

questions.prompt: The other five copies lost their covers. The only one that still ___ its cover is on display.
questions.en: The antecedent of that is the only one. The verb retains agrees with the singular subject of the relative clause.
questions.zh: that 指代唯一一本保有封面的册子 the only one，因此定语从句的谓语用单数 retains。

questions.prompt: What matters to these tenants ___ access after normal business hours.
questions.en: The what-clause names one concern, taking singular is.
questions.zh: what 从句指一个核心需求，用单数系动词 is。

questions.prompt: One of the routes in the new plan ___ the steep section beside the quarry.
questions.en: The singular head one takes avoids. The plural routes belongs to the prepositional phrase.
questions.zh: 主语中心是单数 one，routes 属于介词短语，谓语用 avoids。

questions.prompt: A number of local retailers ___ agreed to test the reusable containers.
questions.en: A number of means several retailers and takes plural agreement.
questions.zh: a number of 表多家商户，谓语用复数 have。

questions.prompt: The number of customers requesting print copies ___ fallen since the change.
questions.en: The subject is the singular number, so use has fallen.
questions.zh: the number of 表顾客人数这个数值，用 has。

questions.prompt: Not only the cashier but also the two guards ___ required to sign the incident log.
questions.en: The nearer subject two guards is plural.
questions.zh: not only…but also 连接主语时，就近的 guards 是复数。

questions.prompt: Every one of these components ___ tested before it leaves the factory.
questions.en: Every one is singular. Is tested forms the passive.
questions.zh: 主语中心是 every one，单数被动用 is tested。

questions.prompt: The receipts enclosed with the letter ___ proof of the dates of purchase.
questions.en: Receipts is the plural subject; letter belongs to the modifier.
questions.zh: 真正主语是复数 receipts，谓语选 provide。

steps.label: 识别名词
steps.detail: boxes 可数复数，fuel 不可数。

steps.label: 可数复数
steps.detail: many、few、fewer 接复数名词；each/every 后接单数。

steps.label: 不可数
steps.detail: much、little、less 表示量；enough 可修饰两类名词。

diagram.caption: much、little、less 表示量；enough 可修饰两类名词。

questions.prompt: Please place one stamp on ___ envelope in the outgoing pile.
questions.en: One stamp per individual envelope calls for each plus a singular noun.
questions.zh: 每个信封一枚邮票，each 后接单数。

questions.prompt: Very ___ information about the proposed rent increase was available.
questions.en: Information is uncountable, so little describes the small amount.
questions.zh: information 不可数，用 little 描述量少。

questions.prompt: Only a ___ seats near the door were left when we booked.
questions.en: A few modifies plural countable seats.
questions.zh: a few 修饰复数可数的 seats。

questions.prompt: We have ___ spare fabric left to cover a whole chair; even a cushion would use it all.
questions.en: Fabric is an uncountable material and the supply is insufficient.
questions.zh: 布料不可数且不足，too little 表量太少。

questions.prompt: ___ of the two freight lifts has its own emergency telephone.
questions.en: Each of the two takes singular has and its.
questions.zh: 两部货梯各自配备电话，each 与 has 呼应。

questions.prompt: The manual covers ___ three sizes listed in the catalogue.
questions.en: All can precede a number and a plural noun.
questions.zh: 三个尺寸全部覆盖，用 all three sizes。

questions.prompt: The inspectors checked every ___ on the east side before lunch.
questions.en: Every takes a singular count noun here.
questions.zh: every 后接单数可数名词 valve。

questions.prompt: There is hardly ___ room for another cabinet between the desks.
questions.en: Hardly any means almost none and can modify uncountable room.
questions.zh: room 指空间，不可数，hardly any 表几乎没有。

questions.prompt: The theater sold ___ tickets to cover the cost of an extra performance.
questions.en: Enough tickets to cover a cost expresses a sufficient quantity.
questions.zh: enough…to 表数量足够，后接可数复数 tickets。

questions.prompt: There were too ___ volunteers to cover all eight counters, so two counters stayed shut.
questions.en: Volunteers is a countable plural and the number was insufficient.
questions.zh: 志愿者人数不足，用 too few。

questions.prompt: Neither plan leaves ___ time for a second delivery before the gate closes.
questions.en: Time here is uncountable; enough marks the amount needed for the extra trip.
questions.zh: time 表不可数的时长，enough time 表所需时间。

questions.prompt: The loading team used a little ___ to protect the corners of the framed prints.
questions.en: A little modifies an uncountable amount of cushioning material.
questions.zh: a little 后须接不可数名词 padding。

questions.prompt: Each of the four vans has room for ___ one pallet; a second pallet will not fit.
questions.en: Exactly one expresses the limit stated in the second clause.
questions.zh: 只能放一个托盘，用 exactly one。

questions.prompt: Of the two quotations, ___ is acceptable: one exceeds the budget and the other misses the deadline.
questions.en: Two options are ruled out individually, so neither is acceptable.
questions.zh: 两个报价各有不合格之处，两者都不行用 neither。

questions.prompt: The storage lockers sold out. There are ___ left for visitors to rent.
questions.en: None can stand alone to mean zero of the plural lockers.
questions.zh: 所有储物柜售罄，none 表示一个也不剩。

steps.label: 先发生
steps.detail: had + 过去分词：在过去参照点前已经完成。

steps.label: 过去参照点
steps.detail: When we arrived yesterday, the crew had left.

steps.label: 未来参照点
steps.detail: by next Friday + will have done：从未来回看已完成的动作。

diagram.caption: by next Friday + will have done：从未来回看已完成的动作。

questions.prompt: At this time tomorrow the crew will be ___ the new cables under the stage.
questions.en: Will be plus an -ing form describes activity in progress at a future time.
questions.zh: 明天此时正在铺设，用将来进行时。

questions.prompt: When we reached the meeting room yesterday, the guests had already ___.
questions.en: Had requires the past participle of leave.
questions.zh: had 后必须接 leave 的过去分词 left。

questions.prompt: The store will send a text as soon as the package ___ at its depot.
questions.en: A future time clause after as soon as uses the present simple.
questions.zh: as soon as 引导的将来时间从句用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: If the inspection goes well tomorrow, the tenants ___ in next Monday.
questions.en: A real future condition takes will in the result clause.
questions.zh: 明天的真实条件与下周的结果，用 will move。

questions.prompt: The billing system will have ___ all the notices by the time the office opens.
questions.en: Will have needs a past participle for future completion.
questions.zh: will have 后接过去分词 sent。

questions.prompt: Until the office ___ last April, all its files had been kept in paper folders.
questions.en: Last April fixes relocation at a completed point in the past.
questions.zh: last April 指明确过去时间，迁址用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: At yesterday's briefing, the director said the branch ___ open the following month.
questions.en: Would expresses the future viewed from the past briefing.
questions.zh: 从昨天的说明会看次月开业，是过去将来时。

questions.prompt: By the time the relief operator arrived, the first operator had been ___ for nine hours.
questions.en: Had been plus the -ing form expresses an activity extending to a past time.
questions.zh: 一直工作到过去交班时点，用过去完成进行时。

questions.prompt: When you return on Friday, the panel will already have ___ the three finalists.
questions.en: Future perfect uses have plus the past participle chosen.
questions.zh: 将来完成时用 choose 的过去分词 chosen。

questions.prompt: We ___ the customer's request yesterday, three days after the original guarantee expired.
questions.en: Yesterday locates receipt in a completed past period.
questions.zh: yesterday 指已结束的过去时间，用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: Before the merger was announced, the two firms had never ___ their customer records.
questions.en: Had never takes a past participle for events before the announcement.
questions.zh: 在宣布之前从未合并资料，用 had never combined。

questions.prompt: The factory is closed now. It ___ production as soon as the parts arrive tomorrow.
questions.en: Production starts in the future after tomorrow's delivery.
questions.zh: 到货在明天，恢复生产也是未来动作。

questions.prompt: By the end of the last financial year, the gallery had ___ enough to buy its new lighting system.
questions.en: The past reporting boundary and had require a past participle.
questions.zh: 截至上一财年末，had 后接过去分词 saved。

questions.prompt: At ten tomorrow morning, the committee will be ___ the appeal in a closed session.
questions.en: Will be plus -ing describes the activity in progress at that future time.
questions.zh: 明天十点正在审理，用将来进行时。

questions.prompt: The reception desk will open after the cleaners ___ their inspection tomorrow.
questions.en: A future time clause with after normally uses present simple.
questions.zh: after 引导的将来时间从句用一般现在时。

steps.label: 看后面的成分
steps.detail: 先找有没有带时态的谓语。

steps.label: 名词短语
steps.detail: during the outage、because of the delay、despite the rain。

steps.label: 完整从句
steps.detail: while the power was off、because we waited、although it rained。

diagram.caption: while the power was off、because we waited、although it rained。

questions.prompt: The lift operated normally ___ the lights in the west wing went out.
questions.en: The contrast is followed by a finite clause with its own verb.
questions.zh: 转折之后为完整从句，选 even though。

questions.prompt: The booth stayed closed ___ a shortage of trained staff.
questions.en: A shortage is a noun phrase giving the reason.
questions.zh: 原因以名词短语出现，用 owing to。

questions.prompt: ___ the two rooms share a wall, their sound systems are separate.
questions.en: Share has its own subject, the two rooms. Although introduces the contrast.
questions.zh: 两间房共墙却各有音响，用 although 引出完整从句。

questions.prompt: Visitors can use a paper ticket ___ showing the code on a phone.
questions.en: Showing follows the prepositional phrase instead of to give an alternative.
questions.zh: instead of 后接动名词，说明纸票替代手机码。

questions.prompt: The team packed by hand ___ the labeling machine was being repaired.
questions.en: The machine was being repaired gives a complete time clause.
questions.zh: 机器正在维修是完整从句，时间连词用 while。

questions.prompt: The committee set a smaller budget ___ its confidence in the new design.
questions.en: The contrast is followed by the noun phrase its confidence.
questions.zh: 虽然对设计有信心却减少预算，名词短语前用 in spite of。

questions.prompt: The van left late ___ the driver had to inspect a warning light.
questions.en: A subject and a finite verb follow the conjunction of reason.
questions.zh: 原因处有 driver 和 had to inspect，要用 because。

questions.prompt: ___ the clerk can release the documents, the owner must sign this page.
questions.en: Before introduces a clause describing the later event.
questions.zh: 交付文件之前需签字，before 后接完整从句。

questions.prompt: The order was split into two shipments ___ the limit on the weight of each crate.
questions.en: The limit is a noun phrase explaining the split.
questions.zh: 限重是分批原因，名词短语前用 because of。

questions.prompt: The technician finished the wiring ___ the building reopened to visitors.
questions.en: The building reopened is a full clause giving a later event.
questions.zh: 楼宇重新开放是完整从句，用 before 说明先后。

questions.prompt: The estimate remains valid ___ the change in the delivery address.
questions.en: The change is a noun phrase expressing a circumstance that does not invalidate the estimate.
questions.zh: 尽管地址变化，估价仍有效，名词前用 despite。

questions.prompt: Boots must be worn ___ the floor has been freshly washed and may be slippery.
questions.en: The reason has an expressed subject and a finite verb.
questions.zh: 原因带有主语和谓语，需要 because。

questions.prompt: The parcel went by rail ___ by air, cutting the shipping charge in half.
questions.en: Rather than connects the alternatives by rail and by air.
questions.zh: rather than 连接两种运输方式，表取舍。

questions.prompt: The office waived the fee ___ the delay at its own dispatch desk.
questions.en: The delay is a noun phrase describing the cause of the waiver.
questions.zh: 原因是名词短语 the delay，选 on account of。

questions.prompt: ___ the staff were closing the front doors, two more groups arrived at reception.
questions.en: Were closing needs its subject the staff within a time clause.
questions.zh: were closing 与 the staff 组成时间从句，需要 while。

steps.label: 先定位线索
steps.detail: 找目的、结果、物品用途或数量关系。

steps.label: 逐个代入
steps.detail: 四个选项的词性相同，观察哪个符合语境。

steps.label: 检验含义
steps.detail: receipts + pay staff back → reimburse；与支付凭证和付款方向一致。

diagram.caption: receipts + pay staff back → reimburse；与支付凭证和付款方向一致。

questions.prompt: The double-booked hall can hold only one group; please ___ the smaller workshop until next week.
questions.en: Move it to a later date.
questions.zh: 改到下周举行，即推迟原定日期。

questions.prompt: Keep the taxi receipt so that the college can ___ you for the fare.
questions.en: Pay somebody back for an expense already paid.
questions.zh: 凭收据偿还先行垫付的车费。

questions.prompt: Please ___ a copy of the signed agreement to your reply so we can open it on screen.
questions.en: An electronic file accompanies the reply.
questions.zh: 把可在屏幕上打开的文件作为邮件附件。

questions.prompt: Before closing the shop, ___ the two cash totals to find out whether they match.
questions.en: The two amounts are checked against one another.
questions.zh: 判断两笔金额是否一致要比较。

questions.prompt: The crack extends through the lens, so the technician must ___ it with a new one.
questions.en: A new lens takes the place of the damaged one.
questions.zh: 用新镜片取代破裂镜片。

questions.prompt: To keep a seat on the early coach, please ___ one through our travel desk.
questions.en: Make a booking for a particular seat.
questions.zh: 通过服务台预订座位。

questions.prompt: To see a parcel’s location at each scan without changing its route, enter its reference number and select the option to ___ it.
questions.en: Follow the changing location of the shipment.
questions.zh: 根据编号追踪包裹的位置。

questions.prompt: The clerk must ___ the cashier's signature against the one on file before releasing cash.
questions.en: Check the signature against a trusted record.
questions.zh: 与存档签名核对是真伪验证。

questions.prompt: We need a crane to ___ the air conditioner onto the roof; it weighs half a ton.
questions.en: A crane raises the heavy unit.
questions.zh: 半吨的设备由起重机吊上屋顶。

questions.prompt: Our laboratory will ___ a sample to find out exactly which metal it contains.
questions.en: Test the composition of an unknown sample.
questions.zh: 要确定金属成分需分析样品。

questions.prompt: This lever allows the operator to ___ the flow of water from a trickle to a steady stream.
questions.en: Change the rate of flow.
questions.zh: 把涓流调成稳定水流，用 adjust。

questions.prompt: To prevent unauthorized reading, the software will ___ the message using a secret key.
questions.en: Encode the contents so that the key is needed to read them.
questions.zh: 用密钥编码以防止未授权阅读。

questions.prompt: The two teams use different units, so please ___ the length from inches to centimeters.
questions.en: Express the same measurement in another unit.
questions.zh: 数值的单位从英寸换算为厘米。

questions.prompt: Please ___ the replacement ticket at the side counter by showing your claim slip.
questions.en: Pick up the ticket in exchange for the slip.
questions.zh: 出示凭条是领取补发车票。

questions.prompt: Our auditors need the original letters; please ___ them in the records room for six years.
questions.en: Keep the documents for the stated period.
questions.zh: 需要保管原信六年以便审计。

questions.prompt: Because the van cannot reach the alley, we must ___ the delivery to a smaller vehicle at the gate.
questions.en: Move the load from one vehicle to another.
questions.zh: 在门口把货转移到较小车辆上。

questions.prompt: Please ___ the two contact lists into a single file and remove duplicate entries.
questions.en: Combine lists into one file.
questions.zh: 两个名单合为一个文件，用 merge。

questions.prompt: The service desk can ___ a replacement badge on the spot if you show identification.
questions.en: Supply a new official badge to its holder.
questions.zh: 核验身份后当场签发新证。

questions.prompt: Use the numbered tabs to ___ the sample cards by thickness, from thinnest to thickest.
questions.en: Arrange items by a specified property.
questions.zh: 按厚度从薄到厚排列是 sort。

questions.prompt: If a seat becomes available, the system will ___ the next person on the waiting list by email.
questions.en: Send that person news of the opening.
questions.zh: 邮件告知候补人有了空位。

questions.prompt: The driver parked nose-first in a narrow dead-end bay. With no room to turn, she must ___ out along the same lane.
questions.en: Move backward when a vehicle cannot turn around.
questions.zh: 无法掉头，就沿原车道倒车退出。

questions.prompt: The handler uses a calibrated scale to ___ each crate before entering its mass on the form.
questions.en: A scale measures mass.
questions.zh: 用秤测量质量，要称重。

questions.prompt: The client asked us to ___ the estimate to reflect a smaller order; the first figure is no longer valid.
questions.en: Change the figure to match new quantities.
questions.zh: 原金额已失效，需按新数量修改估价。

questions.prompt: The device can ___ even a tiny gas leak: when the sensor recognizes gas in the air, the unit sounds an alarm.
questions.en: The sensor recognizes the presence of gas.
questions.zh: 传感器探测到气体后报警。

questions.prompt: The glass is too wide for its frame, so the glazier will ___ two millimeters off one edge.
questions.en: Remove a small amount from the edge.
questions.zh: 玻璃过宽，需要从边缘裁掉一小段。

questions.prompt: To prevent a wait at the machine, the office will ___ breaks so that each team leaves at a different time.
questions.en: Arrange the breaks at different starting times.
questions.zh: 不同小组按不同时间休息，属于错峰安排。

questions.prompt: Call our desk to ___ your pass for another month before the current one expires.
questions.en: Extend the validity of the existing pass.
questions.zh: 在现有通行证到期前续期。

questions.prompt: The pilot project lost its only buyer. The board voted to ___ it entirely, with no restart planned.
questions.en: End the project permanently.
questions.zh: 项目彻底结束且不重启，表示放弃。

questions.prompt: To comply with the spending limit, the team must ___ the total from 800 dollars to 600 dollars.
questions.en: Make the total smaller.
questions.zh: 总金额由八百降至六百，是削减。

questions.prompt: Before we mark an order paid, the clerk must ___ the payment to the correct invoice number.
questions.en: Associate a particular payment with its invoice.
questions.zh: 收款要与对应发票号相匹配。

questions.prompt: A second worker must ___ the ladder at its base to keep it from tipping while the sign is installed.
questions.en: Hold the ladder stable during use.
questions.zh: 安装时在梯脚扶稳，防止倾倒。

questions.prompt: The grant covers tuition alone. Students must ___ the cost of travel themselves.
questions.en: Bear a cost means be responsible for paying it.
questions.zh: 学费外的差旅费需自行承担。

questions.prompt: The new lock will ___ the previous model, which the factory will no longer make.
questions.en: Take the old model's place in production.
questions.zh: 旧型号停产，新型号取而代之。

questions.prompt: The bank agreed to ___ the monthly fee for tenants who had been charged twice.
questions.en: Give up the right to collect a fee.
questions.zh: 针对被重复收费的租户免除月费。

questions.prompt: The editor removed the misleading clause but chose to ___ the remaining text exactly as submitted.
questions.en: Keep the original wording unchanged.
questions.zh: 其余文字完全照原稿保留。

questions.prompt: For the warranty claim, the recipient's signed ___ establishes that the package actually arrived.
questions.en: A signed acknowledgment documents delivery.
questions.zh: 签收回单可证明包裹已经送达。

questions.prompt: The clerk used the customer's travel ___ to find the flight number and hotel booking for each night.
questions.en: A plan listing flights and overnight stops.
questions.zh: 同时列出航班及逐日住宿的是行程表。

questions.prompt: The free training has a fixed ___ of twelve because there are only twelve workstations.
questions.en: The number of people the room can accommodate.
questions.zh: 工作台数量决定可接纳人数。

questions.prompt: The purchase date is missing. Check the dated ___ that the shop printed when you paid.
questions.en: A till produces a proof of purchase at payment.
questions.zh: 付款时收银台打印的是购物凭证。

questions.prompt: Once the customer pays, the outstanding ___ on this invoice will drop to zero.
questions.en: The money still owed is the outstanding balance.
questions.zh: 发票未付金额称为 outstanding balance。

questions.prompt: An employee who recommends a candidate earns a bonus for a successful ___ if that candidate is hired.
questions.en: Passing a candidate's name to a recruiter is a referral.
questions.zh: 向招聘方推荐候选人属于 referral。

questions.prompt: The customer paid only a small ___ today; the rest is due when the sofa arrives.
questions.en: An initial part payment reserves the order.
questions.zh: 先付少量，余款交货时付，即订金。

questions.prompt: The machine stops at ten each evening for ___, including oiling the hinges and checking the belts.
questions.en: Oiling and belt checks are routine upkeep.
questions.zh: 上油和检查皮带属于设备保养。

questions.prompt: The policy offers full ___ against water damage up to the stated limit.
questions.en: Insurance protection against a specified risk.
questions.zh: 在限额内承保水损，coverage 指保障范围。

questions.prompt: The panel rejected the proposal because its cost exceeded the annual ___ approved by the board.
questions.en: An approved spending plan limits the available funds.
questions.zh: 董事会核准的年度预算限制可支出金额。

questions.prompt: Everyone has submitted a bid. The committee will choose a ___ to supply the uniforms for the entire chain.
questions.en: The selected business will sell goods to the chain.
questions.zh: 经过投标选出的供货商为 vendor。

questions.prompt: After the drains overflowed, a safety ___ found that a valve had been left shut.
questions.en: A formal check identified the cause of a safety problem.
questions.zh: 通过安全检查发现阀门关闭的问题。

questions.prompt: The shop offers a two-year ___ under which it repairs manufacturing defects free of charge.
questions.en: A warranty promises repairs for specified defects.
questions.zh: 承诺在期限内免费修复制造缺陷，是保修。

questions.prompt: Saturday training is optional. The survey asks only whether employees want to attend, so it measures their ___.
questions.en: The survey asks whether staff want to attend.
questions.zh: 自愿活动要调查的是参与意愿。

questions.prompt: Two suppliers offered identical rates, so length of service became the deciding ___ in the choice.
questions.en: The factor is the consideration that determines a decision.
questions.zh: 价格相同后，服务年限成为决定因素。

questions.prompt: The workshop received a new ___ of screws at noon; the driver unloaded five cartons.
questions.en: A delivery of goods in several cartons is a shipment.
questions.zh: 司机卸下的五箱螺钉是一批到货。

questions.prompt: A rigid wall blocks the route shown on the old plan, so the engineer drew a ___ around it.
questions.en: An alternative route goes around an obstruction.
questions.zh: 绕开墙体的替代路线为 detour。

questions.prompt: The parcel was undamaged, but an error in the street number caused a two-day delivery ___.
questions.en: A late arrival is a delay.
questions.zh: 门牌错误使送达时间延后两天。

questions.prompt: Under the new ___, department heads must report any lost key within one hour.
questions.en: A rule governing employee conduct is a policy.
questions.zh: 规定员工必须如何处置遗失钥匙的是制度。

questions.prompt: Please sign the equipment ___, which records who has the tripod and the date it must be returned.
questions.en: A register records loans and their holders.
questions.zh: 签字登记领用人及归还日期，属于借用登记簿。

questions.prompt: The technician heard a faint mechanical ___ from a loose fan cover; the noise stopped when she tightened its screw.
questions.en: A loose screw can make a rattling sound.
questions.zh: 螺丝松动会发出轻微的咔嗒声。

questions.prompt: The hiring panel asked for a writing ___, so the applicant enclosed an article she had edited.
questions.en: An article demonstrates the applicant's work.
questions.zh: 附上编辑过的文章是提供作品样本。

questions.prompt: No one can enter the secure area without written ___ from a shift manager.
questions.en: A manager must give formal permission.
questions.zh: 进入受限区需主管书面授权。

questions.prompt: The ticket office keeps a cash ___ for making change when the counter first opens.
questions.en: A cash float is ready money kept for giving change.
questions.zh: 营业初期用于找零的备用金为 cash float。

questions.prompt: The inventor obtained a ___ giving her the right to prevent others from making the device for a limited term.
questions.en: A patent grants exclusive rights to an invention.
questions.zh: 发明人在一定期限内拥有独占权，对应专利。

questions.prompt: The factory scheduled a planned ___ during which every production line would be switched off.
questions.en: An interval when all production is stopped is a shutdown.
questions.zh: 所有生产线关闭的停产期称为 shutdown。

questions.prompt: A customer who wants text alerts must give explicit ___ by ticking the empty box.
questions.en: Ticking the box actively grants permission.
questions.zh: 主动勾选空框表示明确同意。

questions.prompt: The booking system left a thirty-minute ___ between interviews so staff could finish their notes.
questions.en: Time separating two appointments is an interval.
questions.zh: 两次面谈之间的时间间隔是 interval。

questions.prompt: The spare-parts list shows a persistent ___ of washers: demand is sixty per day and supply is only forty.
questions.en: Demand being greater than the available supply indicates a shortage.
questions.zh: 需求六十而供给仅四十，属于短缺。

questions.prompt: The two architects reached a ___: each would give up one requested change in exchange for keeping another.
questions.en: Both sides give up something to reach agreement.
questions.zh: 双方各有让步以达成一致，为妥协方案。

questions.prompt: The cottage is empty in August; the rental calendar lists it as ___ for the entire month.
questions.en: An empty rental that can be booked is available.
questions.zh: 空置可订的房源标记为 available。

questions.prompt: Coffee is ___ in the meeting suite, so guests will see no beverage charge on their bill.
questions.en: Complimentary means provided without a charge.
questions.zh: 账单免收饮品费，即免费提供。

questions.prompt: The first price is ___, since the final amount depends on the size of the order.
questions.en: A price subject to later revision is tentative.
questions.zh: 最终金额未定，初步报价是暂定的。

questions.prompt: The display has a ___ shelf that visitors can lift out for cleaning without tools.
questions.en: It can be taken out without tools.
questions.zh: 可徒手取出的搁板是 removable。

questions.prompt: This archive is ___ to staff with a current access card; other people need an escort.
questions.en: Authorized staff can enter the archive.
questions.zh: 持卡员工可以进入，accessible to 指可进入。

questions.prompt: The folded trolley is ___ enough to fit under the counter rather than blocking the aisle.
questions.en: Small overall size makes it fit under the counter.
questions.zh: 强调收起后体积小，用 compact。

questions.prompt: The attached map is ___: it shows the current access road and the gate that opened yesterday.
questions.en: It includes the latest change to the road layout.
questions.zh: 含昨天新开的门，表示资料是最新的。

questions.prompt: A rise in early orders made a second delivery run ___; without it, half the orders would arrive late.
questions.en: The second run is required to meet the delivery deadline.
questions.zh: 没有额外车次便无法准时，因此它是必要的。

questions.prompt: The analysis omits the last quarter and is therefore ___.
questions.en: Missing a period leaves the report unfinished.
questions.zh: 缺少最后一个季度的数据，分析不完整。

questions.prompt: The two rates are ___: both are 42 dollars per crate with no extra charge.
questions.en: They have exactly the same amount and conditions.
questions.zh: 金额和条件完全一致，用 identical。

questions.prompt: The paper pass is ___ after the printed date; the scanner rejects it the next morning.
questions.en: A pass that is no longer accepted has lost its validity.
questions.zh: 超过日期无法使用，票证无效。

questions.prompt: A technician wears ___ gloves so that live wires cannot pass current to the hands.
questions.en: Insulation prevents electric current from flowing.
questions.zh: 防止电流通过需要绝缘手套。

questions.prompt: The unit runs on batteries and fits inside a toolbox, making it ___ enough for fieldwork.
questions.en: It can be carried and used away from a mains supply.
questions.zh: 可随身带到现场使用，就是便携。

questions.prompt: The board insisted that the review be ___: nobody connected to either bidder was permitted to take part.
questions.en: No connection to the bidders means the reviewer is independent.
questions.zh: 审查人不隶属任何投标方，表示独立性。

questions.prompt: The fee is ___ only if the class is cancelled; otherwise customers cannot get it back.
questions.en: The condition concerns getting a payment back.
questions.zh: 发生取消才退钱，refundable 表示可退。

questions.prompt: The rules are ___: every operator must follow them, including temporary staff.
questions.en: Must follow establishes an obligation.
questions.zh: 所有人必须遵守说明规则具有强制性。

questions.prompt: The venue offers ___ access to wheelchair users by providing a lift that bypasses every stair.
questions.en: The lift allows entry without using steps.
questions.zh: 电梯绕过所有台阶，表示无台阶通行。

questions.prompt: The button has a ___ surface so wet fingers do not slide off it.
questions.en: A textured surface provides grip.
questions.zh: 有纹理的表面提供摩擦力。

questions.prompt: Several branches depend on the same pump. Its reliable operation is therefore ___ to the whole network.
questions.en: Failure would affect several branches, making the pump essential.
questions.zh: 多个网点依赖这台泵，可靠运行至关重要。

questions.prompt: The studio is ___ by appointment only; staff do not let visitors walk in unannounced.
questions.en: The appointment controls who may enter.
questions.zh: 只有预约才准入，accessible 表可进入。

questions.prompt: A buyer cannot be identified from this receipt: it has no name, address, or account number. In that sense, the receipt is ___.
questions.en: No details identify the customer.
questions.zh: 收据上没有任何标识顾客的信息，故为匿名。

questions.prompt: The second offer is ___ to the first in price: each costs exactly nine dollars.
questions.en: Equivalent in price means costing the same amount.
questions.zh: 两项价格相同，equivalent to 表等同。

questions.prompt: The test run was ___ because every sensor returned the target reading on the first attempt.
questions.en: Meeting every test target demonstrates success.
questions.zh: 首次即达到所有测试目标，说明试运行成功。

questions.prompt: The new ticket is ___ only on this route, so changing to the ferry requires a separate fare.
questions.en: Route restrictions specify where a ticket is accepted.
questions.zh: 票只在本线路有效，换乘另购。

questions.prompt: The extra order is ___ on receiving a deposit by noon; without the deposit it will be cancelled.
questions.en: Conditional on means dependent on a stated requirement.
questions.zh: 订单是否生效取决于午前收款。

questions.prompt: The system copies every file ___, without requiring anyone to press a button.
questions.en: No manual action is required.
questions.zh: 无需按键，说明复制自动进行。

questions.prompt: The driver was told to deliver the samples ___, with no stops on the way to the clinic.
questions.en: A journey without intermediate stops is direct.
questions.zh: 途中不停站，表示径直送达。

questions.prompt: To avoid a one-digit routing error, slow down and read both numbers ___, checking each digit against the original.
questions.en: Checking every digit to prevent an error calls for careful reading.
questions.zh: 题干强调逐位核对以防误投，描述这种细致做法用 carefully。

questions.prompt: The broken gate was closed ___ for the weekend; normal entry will resume on Monday.
questions.en: The closure ends on a specified day.
questions.zh: 周一恢复说明关闭是暂时的。

questions.prompt: The two clinics ordered gloves ___, placing separate orders through different accounts.
questions.en: Separate orders and accounts indicate independent action.
questions.zh: 各自账户分别订购，说明彼此独立。

questions.prompt: The desk was staffed ___ throughout the storm: one clerk always took over before another left.
questions.en: There was no unstaffed interval.
questions.zh: 始终有人接班，没有空档，故为不间断。

questions.prompt: A faint smell of smoke spread ___ at first, taking an hour to reach the far end of the hall.
questions.en: Taking an hour indicates slow progression.
questions.zh: 花一小时才扩散到远端，说明逐渐蔓延。

questions.prompt: The company agreed to divide the fee ___ between the two branches, so each will pay exactly half.
questions.en: Exactly half for each branch means equal shares.
questions.zh: 两方各付一半，表示均分。

questions.prompt: Incorrect stamps must be returned ___ to the issuing office; sending them to payroll delays the replacement.
questions.en: The issuing office is the intended destination without an intermediary.
questions.zh: 应直接寄回签发部门，不能经薪酬部门转递。

questions.prompt: The handbook was written ___ for novice welders: it starts with lighting the torch safely.
questions.en: The handbook targets a particular group of readers.
questions.zh: 手册专门面向初学焊工，specifically for 表特定对象。
